comment: xfail registry for the full_api_ext table. Same rules as known.json: an
entry that starts passing is reported as xpass and FAILS the run, so the
registry has to be updated when a fix lands.
Everything here was measured against test_fullapi_ext_rust. Note that the
Rust dispatch validates by LIDL TYPE even where the Rust binding is untyped
(`[bstr]` binds as serde_json::Value but is still checked against
Ty::Arr(Ty::Bstr)) — that is what turns E2 into a precise error with a path
instead of a silently wrong value.

fixed.fixed_by: logos-protocol 362b03f — one canonical LIDL <-> JSON codec (#29)
fixed.what: bytes at depth mangled (E1), an empty nested bstr arriving as null (E2), and M1 seen through a record field (E3).
fixed.verified: all 22 registered cells went xpass on the re-pin, and the two ext providers now agree on every case — the differential went from 10 pass / 9 xfail to 19/19.
